name: atile-ksteps-gh200
design: scratchpad design-atile/DESIGN.md with design-review/REVIEW.md section 3 fixes applied
status: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY PAGE: no page below exists when this is committed
card: one Lambda gpu_1x_gh200, rental 1 (one board for every page, the 8x7B denominators included); lock 1710 byte pages, treads 1..9, three arms
pages_order_note: the tp8 r3c pages are taken only after the registered tp8 floor capture (2026-09-30 registration) is pushed
arm_scored: PRIVATE only (its excess over n is A-tile reads alone: every slab key is distinct)
unit: q = DCR.r3_q: (DRAM bytes - n x operand) / W_g, per GEMM; f = (q - n) x 128 / (63 n) for w2 (P_w2 = 64, ATILE/SLAB = 1/2 on every Mixtral shard)

candidates.R0: the registered 8x7B MIX fit (2026-09-27 lock pages) through cross_model_predict.target_geometry/target_design; nothing refitted
candidates.R1: content-keyed w1 A (harness routing classes), one A survival law for both GEMMs (w1 fill, w2 ws), no duration term; scripts/atile_pooled_fit.py --form mix
candidates.R2: R1 x s(ks) = (1 + ks/k0_A)^(-a_A) on every A distance, ks = K/BLOCK_K; --form mixT (the fit runs to the exponential limit: s = exp(-ks a_A/k0_A))

R1.label: includes diagnosis models (their pages were seen)

R2.label: includes diagnosis models (their pages were seen)

dropped: the knee form with the knee fixed at 40 k-steps (read off JetMoE/Phi, diagnosis models): not registered
harness_note: the w1 A sharing is produced by SWEEP.balanced_ids -> realize_counts (heap greedy, ties by expert id: E/k classes of k experts with identical token sets). Real top-k routing does not do this. The content-keyed term and its test model R3's HARNESS, not the hardware; wave_split_bytes.DESIGN_KEYS now carries routing so a page of another routing cannot join a card.

T1 content-keyed w1 A (separates R1/R2 f.cells: PRIVATE w1 at G=128, Qwen2-57B and OLMoE, every n >= 2
T1 content-keyed w1 A (separates R1/R2 f.pass: within 2% of R1 (primary) at every n >= 2, and R0 off by more than 5% (Qwen2) / 3% (OLMoE)
T1 content-keyed w1 A (separates R1/R2 f.falsified: the measured w1 q at G=128 nearer R0 than R1 at any n >= 4

T2 duration term (separates R2 from ever.cells: PRIVATE w2 n=9: rho42 = f(tp4 G=64) / f(8x7B G=16), rho84 = f(tp2 G=64) / f(8x7B G=32), numerator and denominator from ONE board (same-board 8x7B pages, not the 09-27 ones)

noise.source: 90th percentile of the per-call standard error of PRIVATE w2 q over the 16 cells G >= 8, n >= 6 of the 8x7B 09-27 lock pages (3 calls a cell; median 0.0088); sigma_f = sigma_q x 128 / (63 x 9) on each of numerator and denominator, combined in quadrature; band = predicted rho +- 2 sigma
noise.board_to_board_note: 09-25 against 09-27 8x7B PRIVATE w2 q differ up to 2.8% (G=64 n=6): a cross-board ratio would carry that, which is why the denominators are re-measured on the same board

T2 duration term (separates R2 from ever.rule: a candidate is FALSIFIED when both measured rho fall outside its own band. Both rho inside R2 (primary) bands and outside R1/R0: every byte law refuted, the duration term supported. Both inside R1 or R0 bands: the duration term refuted. Both between the bands: every candidate refuted (the shrink exists but not in this form). One in, one out: inconclusive, reported as such.
T2 duration term (separates R2 from ever.weak_row: the 21 MiB row (8x7B G=8, tp2 G=16, tp4 G=32, tp8 G=64) separates R1 from R2 by 0.09 to 0.14 against 0.10 to 0.04 in f; scored as supporting evidence only
T2 duration term (separates R2 from ever.confound: along each iso-working-set row L (8 -> 64) and W_c/L (66 -> 8 columns in flight) change with the k-steps; a byte law with a columns-in-flight term also predicts a rising row. The separator (8x7B G=32 at BLOCK_K 32/num_stages 8 against 128/2: k-steps at fixed L, bytes and W_c) needs --block-k and is RENTAL 2, not this run.

T3 G=1 credit (separates content-keyed s.cells: PRIVATE w1 G=1 n=1 on the tp2, tp4, tp8 G=1 pages the L2-survival registration takes
T3 G=1 credit (separates content-keyed s.band: +-0.0010 in q around each candidate: the worst |measured - R1 (primary)| over the eight published G=1 n=1 w1 PRIVATE cells is 0.00098 (8x22B), the rms about 0.0005
T3 G=1 credit (separates content-keyed s.rule: pass if q - 1 is inside R1 (primary)'s band and outside R0's; tp2 is not discriminating (the share distance, W_w1/E = 117 MB, is past the L2, so R1 keeps only -0.0004 of the -0.0011 credit) and is a record
T3 G=1 credit (separates content-keyed s.note: the design's "within 5% of q" is replaced: 5% of q = 1 is 10 x every credit

T4 score (each candidate on its own).cells: every PRIVATE cell, w1 and w2, n = 1..9, of the scoring pages above (G=1 pages excluded)
T4 score (each candidate on its own).pass: rms <= 2% and no G >= 32, n >= 6 cell beyond 4%
T4 score (each candidate on its own).out_of_scope: 8x22B w1 G=64 deep-n miss (not on these pages)

validity: tp8 and tp4 lock pages will likely FAIL V10 (short kernels: JetMoE/OLMoE lock pages read 1641-1688 MHz against 1710). V10 does not gate any score here: DRAM bytes are clock-free (09-27 G=2 base-clock against lock bytes agree to 0.03% w1, 0.8% w2). A page missing a GEMM's occupancy limit, or whose grid the walk refuses, scores nothing.
reproduce: python scripts/atile_pooled_fit.py --form {mix,mixT} --cards <lock1710 dirs> --out R.json; python scripts/cross_model_predict.py --bytes-only --target T --counters <8x7B 09-27 lock1710> --groups G,.. --byte-params R1.json R2.json
